content:
Jules: heads-up — pre-promote verification failed for release/2026-04-01 (commit d4e5f6). deploybot aborted the promote due to mismatched checksums between the CI artifact and registry blob. tagging @marta @yusuf for quick decision.

deploybot: Pre-promote check failed at 1723456789. Reason: manifest digest validation failed. Manifest references layer sha256:aa22bb but `HEAD` returned sha256:zz99yy. Command: `deploybot verify --release release/2026-04-01`. Logs: https://ci.internal/verify/114 (requires auth).

Marta: saw this locally too. CI publish reported success but registry GET returned a different digest. Could be either a partial multipart finalize or a bad copy in the storage backend.

Yusuf: change window in ~30m. Options: 1) pin to prod image (fast, low risk), 2) delay window 20m to attempt quick republish to mirror and re-verify. Product preference?

PM-bot: product prefers to avoid pinning if possible. OK with a short delay (<=20m) if it restores artifact integrity. Please set a hard cutoff.

Jules: agreed. We'll hold for 20m. @deploybot put promote on hold until 1723458009 (20m). If verify still fails at cutoff, pin to sha256:prod-alpha and open INFR-4100.

deploybot: Promote placed on hold until 1723458009 per request 'hold-for-republish-verify'. Will auto-abort at cutoff.

Marta: attempting a republish now to the mirror and forcing a manifest push: `ci/publish --commit d4e5f6 --mirror --force-verify`. Also kicking a quick `skopeo inspect` after push to compare raw digests.

Yusuf: also bumped registry GC grace by 30m and paused pruner for the repo prefix while republish runs.

deploybot: republish job queued. Verifier pending.

Marta: republish finished at 1723456850. `skopeo inspect --raw docker://mirror.internal/app:ci-d4e5f6` shows manifest and layer digests consistent (sha256:aa22bb).

deploybot: re-running pre-promote verify. Result: OK. All manifest layer digests match expected values.

Jules: great. Run two fast canaries then full promote. Canaries should catch any remaining propagation issues.

deploybot: canaries started: ci/staging/canary#120..121.

Yusuf: canaries both passed. Proceeding to promote. Command: `deploybot promote --release release/2026-04-01 --reason "republish-verified-pre-promote"`

deploybot: Promotion succeeded. prod now at ci-d4e5f6. Promotion timestamp: 1723456885.

Jules: I'm opening INFR-4100 to document the failure mode and follow-ups: add a pre-promote HEAD/digest check (already in play but will harden), add force-mirror-after-publish step, and guard GC/pruner to not finalize content within the publish window. Assigning to Marta and Yusuf.

Marta: will open a small deploybot PR to surface a stricter pre-promote verification step and add a retry-on-mismatch path that auto-triggers republish to mirror.

Yusuf: will follow up on storage backend tracing to see why the original copy diverged. Thanks all, closing the hold. :white_check_mark:
